item.title: Buying a SIM card
item.context_text: You are in a new city for a language course. Your phone needs a local SIM card. You go to a small phone shop near your hostel.
item.objective_text: Choose a SIM plan, understand the shop assistant, and send your new number to a friend.
item.target_grammar: can for requests and permission (Can I pay by card?)
item.cultural_note: In many countries you need your passport to buy a SIM card. Take it with you to the shop.
success_conditions: Find the price of the plan you want
Understand how to pay and where your new number is
Ask for a plan and send your new number to a friend

children.title: Read the price board
children.instructions: Read the price board in the shop. Then answer the questions.
children.prompt_text:
SIM CARDS
Plan S: 5 GB data — 10 euros a month
Plan M: 15 GB data — 15 euros a month
Plan L: 50 GB data — 25 euros a month
All plans: free calls in the country.
Please show your passport.

questions.explanation: The board says "Plan M: 15 GB data — 15 euros a month".

questions.prompt: What do you need to show?
questions.explanation: The board says "Please show your passport."

children.title: Ask for a plan
children.instructions: The shop assistant asks you a question. Answer out loud. Say which plan you want and how you want to pay.
children.prompt_text: Shop assistant: Hello! Which one would you like?
children.goal: Ask for one plan and say how you want to pay.

points.label: say how you want to pay

children.model_answer: Hello. I would like Plan M, please. Can I pay by card?

children.title: Listen to the shop assistant
children.instructions: Listen to the shop assistant. Then answer the questions. You can listen again.
children.prompt_text: OK, Plan M. That is fifteen euros. You can pay by card or in cash. Can I see your passport, please? Thank you. Here is your SIM card. Your new number is on the card. Have a nice day!

questions.explanation: The assistant says "You can pay by card or in cash."
The assistant says "Your new number is on the card."

children.title: Send your new number
children.instructions: Your friend Aziz cannot call you. Write a short message. Say your phone is OK, say you have a new SIM card, and give him your new number.
children.prompt_text: Aziz: Hi! I can't call you. Is your phone OK?
children.goal: Tell Aziz about your new SIM card and give him the number.

points.label: say it is a new SIM card

children.model_answer: Hi Aziz! Yes, my phone is fine. I have a new SIM card. My new number is 07700 900123. Please call me!
